verdict.rationale: Capacities provides AI-generated insights via AI Chats that answer based on user's notes, AI Property Auto-Fill using model knowledge, AI Image Analysis extracting text/metadata, and an assistant that can plan multi-step work and propose creates/updates for approval. This is first-party documented but lacks independent hands-on verification of insight quality. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of AI insight usefulness, and no evidence of proactive/unprompted suggestions beyond user-initiated chats.
